knowledge:
- key_parameters: permutationTimes=The number of random permutations to perform for calculating nominal P-values (e.g., 100) ;; max_p_value=The maximum P-value threshold for filtering curves to draw in drawEScurve ;; min_es=The minimum enrichment score threshold for filtering curves to draw in drawEScurve ;; curveInfoDataFrame=The data frame containing curve information generated by asebSites or asebProteins, passed to drawStat
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use when you have identified lysine acetylation sites or proteins and want to predict which specific KAT-family (such as CBP/P300 or GCN5/PCAF) is responsible for their acetylation.
- pitfalls: Nominal P-values are calculated, making it difficult to establish a hard significance threshold; users should rank sites and prioritize those with relatively lower P-values and higher enrichment scores. Ensure that the background set and predefined set are correctly matched for the specific KAT-family being tested (e.g., background_sites.fa with predefined_sites.fa for CBP/P300, and background_sites2.fa with predefined_sites2.fa for GCN5/PCAF).

workflows.name: site_specific_prediction
workflows.intent: Predict which specific lysine sites can be acetylated by a specific KAT-family and visualize the running-sum enrichment score curves.
input: sites_to_test.fa (FASTA file containing query lysine sites to test)
workflows.stages: 1. Load sequences using readSequence ;; 2. Run site-specific prediction using asebSites ;; 3. Draw enrichment score curves using drawEScurve
workflows.code:
backgroundSites <- readSequence(system.file("extdata", "background_sites.fa", package="ASEB")) 
prodefinedSites <- readSequence(system.file("extdata", "predefined_sites.fa", package="ASEB"))
testSites <- readSequence(system.file("extdata", "sites_to_test.fa", package="ASEB"))
resultList <- asebSites(backgroundSites, prodefinedSites, testSites, permutationTimes=100)
resultList$results[1:2,]
drawEScurve(resultList$curveInfo, max_p_value=0.1, min_es=0.1)

workflows.name: protein_specific_prediction
workflows.intent: Predict all lysine sites on specific proteins that can be acetylated by a specific KAT-family and visualize the P-values and enrichment scores.
input: proteins_to_test.fa (FASTA file containing query proteins to test)
workflows.stages: 1. Load sequences using readSequence ;; 2. Run protein-specific prediction using asebProteins ;; 3. Draw P-values and enrichment scores for all sites on the protein using drawStat
workflows.code:
backgroundSites <- readSequence(system.file("extdata", "background_sites.fa", package="ASEB")) 
prodefinedSites <- readSequence(system.file("extdata", "predefined_sites.fa", package="ASEB"))
testProteins <- readSequence(system.file("extdata", "proteins_to_test.fa", package="ASEB"))
resultList <- asebProteins(backgroundSites, prodefinedSites, testProteins, permutationTimes=100)
resultList$results[1:2,]
drawStat(curveInfoDataFrame=resultList$curveInfo)
